# Comment-driven media replacement benchmark

Work from the unresolved comments in the deck. Do not assume the concrete task
from this prompt: discover it through the comments API, navigate to its slide,
inspect the current slide and the commented context, and implement the request.

You may use local graphics and video tooling to create a better replacement
asset. Import generated media through the documented asset endpoint; do not
embed temporary filesystem paths. Preserve unrelated slide content, slide IDs,
order, builds, notes, and comments.

Preview before applying. Inspect the full-size Before and After render, revise
until the replacement is attractive and legible, and apply one labelled,
revision-bound change. Verify the applied slide in the real player. Only then
reply to the original comment with a concise verification note, resolve the
original comment and your reply, and re-read the comments list to confirm that
the thread has no unresolved entries.
